title: Akil knows about the amputee athlete film his mother watched downstairs

tellings.quote: movie of athlete whose leg was amputed and he got into Special Olympics

plain: A mother in New Jersey named Manisha says her son Akil, one of the children in a documentary about telepathy by the filmmaker Ky Dickens, knew about a film she had watched downstairs without him, a "movie of athlete whose leg was amputed and he got into Special Olympics". She tells it on the show as something she saw herself, offered as a sign that the boy could pick up what was in her mind.
